body_weight_lb.description: Default 180. Displayed load = load_bw * body_weight_lb, snapped to 5 lb unless equipment lists specific sizes.

sports.description: Sports the return-to-sport levels are programmed for. Default: soccer, football.

cable_stack.description: Cable stack available. Default true. David's stack is 5-55 lb in 5 lb plates.

cable_stack_lb.description: Available cable-stack plate settings in pounds. Default 5 through 55 in 5 lb steps. Empty means snap to 5 lb.

sitting_min.description: Minutes of sitting to first pressure; default 20. Sitting has its own tolerance.

post_workout.description: Default on_session_complete: prompted when a session is completed, not on a schedule

clean_exposures_required.description: Clean exposures needed to advance one rung; default 2.

load_bw.description: fraction of body weight (0.75 = 75% BW); per hand when load_note says so

Dose.description: One rung of a ladder. Exactly one field differs between consecutive rungs.

censored.description: true if breaks were taken before pressure appeared

first_pressure_min.description: Minutes of sitting when local pressure first reached 3/10

censored.description: true if the sit block ended or was switched before pressure appeared

flared.description: true if sitting flared symptoms today
